cross_item.pattern: Key letter distribution is balanced (A 8, B 8, C 7, D 7); no runs of the same letter beyond three (D at 28-30). No positional tell.

'Pick the changed value, not the usual one' in schedule/procedure questions. Keys are the change in most fact items, but Q3 (unchanged undergrad schedule) and Q10 (reverted clinic) key the default, and without the transcript you cannot tell which option is the default anyway.
Concession/purpose priors in 'Why does the speaker say' items: room-capacity -> moved (Q8), 'Yes, it is noisy' -> benefit (Q17). The other six intent items have plausible competing options.
Key is the most specific / longest option (room number plus timing qualifier) in Q7 and Q29; not consistent elsewhere (Q1, Q2, Q19, Q26 keys are not uniquely specific).
Two-attribute grids (day x time, place x time) where the key is the cell combining the two non-default values: needs transcript to know which values are defaults; no grid cell is always keyed.
